import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

engine = create_async_engine(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"], pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)


async def get_session() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    async with SessionLocal() as session:

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass

import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import User, WebSession

TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://login.ledgerly.app/oauth2/token"
USERINFO_ENDPOINT = "https://login.ledgerly.app/oauth2/userinfo"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Identity:
    email: str
    subject: str


async def exchange_code(code: str, verifier: str) -> Identity:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
        token = await client.post(
            TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
            data={
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "code": code,
                "code_verifier": verifier,
                "client_id": os.environ["SSO_CLIENT_ID"],
                "client_secret": os.environ["SSO_CLIENT_SECRET"],
            },
        )
        token.raise_for_status()
        info = await client.get(USERINFO_ENDPOINT, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token.json()['access_token']}"})
        info.raise_for_status()
    body = info.json()
    return Identity(email=body["email"], subject=body["sub"])


async def start_web_session(session: AsyncSession, identity: Identity) -> str:
    user = await session.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == identity.email.lower()))
    if user is None:
        raise PermissionError("no account for this identity")
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    session.add(WebSession(token=token, user_id=user.id, ttl_seconds=43200))
    await session.commit()
    return token

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import logging

from portal.extensions import db
from portal.models import Payment

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def apply_payment_event(event):
    if event.get("type") != "payment.succeeded":
        log.debug("ignoring %s", event.get("type"))
        return
    data = event["data"]
    payment = Payment.query.filter_by(external_id=data["id"]).first()
    if payment is None:
        payment = Payment(external_id=data["id"], amount_cents=data["amount"], status="succeeded")
        db.session.add(payment)
    else:
        payment.status = "succeeded"
    db.session.commit()

from flask import Flask

from flask import Flask

from portal.db import close_db
from portal.extensions import db, login_manager


def create_app(config_object="portal.config.ProductionConfig"):
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.from_object(config_object)
    if not app.config.get("SECRET_KEY"):
        raise RuntimeError("SECRET_KEY must be set")

    db.init_app(app)
    login_manager.init_app(app)
    app.teardown_appcontext(close_db)

    from portal.views import register

    register(app)
    return app


@login_manager.user_loader
def load_user(user_id):
    from portal.models import User

    return db.session.get(User, int(user_id))

import logging

from portal.extensions import db
from portal.models import Payment

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def apply_payment_event(event):
    if event.get("type") != "payment.succeeded":
        log.debug("ignoring %s", event.get("type"))
        return
    data = event["data"]
    payment = Payment.query.filter_by(external_id=data["id"]).first()
    if payment is None:
        payment = Payment(external_id=data["id"], amount_cents=data["amount"], status="succeeded")
        db.session.add(payment)
    else:
        payment.status = "succeeded"
    db.session.commit()
